senses: to reproach, taunt, blaspheme, defy, jeopardise, rail, upbraid

strongs.def: to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter
strongs.kjv: betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid
strongs.from: a primitive root; also denominative (from H2779 (חֹרֶף))
